lines.en: : Master...are you really sure you want to order all this? Because I know you’re obsessed with me and everything, but this seems excessive by even your standards.
: Money is naught but a renewable resource, Uta-chan. And it’s only a matter of time until my bank account is replenished.
: I can’t believe you’re still mooching off the school like that.
: It feels like you’ve been on break longer than you were even a teacher at this point. And that this money would probably be better spent on educating girls like Miku who need it the most.
: Correct me if I’m wrong here, but I remember you being right behind her in the grade rankings.

: Your time away from the podium has clearly confused you. I am a smart girl who does and says smart things. Like how you should be more financially responsible than this, Master. I’m worried about you.
It’s a late night for me again.

Osako, who was the only other girl working tonight on account of Chika still being broken, left a short while ago. And without any other customers around and the cafe already being closed, it’s just Uta and me left now.
Which, if I were not a good man, would mean that she is mere minutes away from being bent over the table and violently fingered next to an omelet.
I have chosen not to desecrate this holy land, though. And am more than happy simply receiving unsolicited financial advice until she ultimately kicks me out.
Which probably should have happened by now, to be honest. But the two of us do have a history of staying up late together, so...I guess this is just more of that.
I would like to apologize to all of the starving children in Africa, though. There is no way I can eat all of this.
: There’s no need to worry about me, Uta. Just accept the generous commission you’re earning off of my bill and put it toward your next Halloween costume.
: And now you’re making up holidays to try and trick me into saying something dumb? How dare you, Master.
: Oh, right. Halloween is gone.
: God, I hope the next reset fixes that. I’m not good with change. Especially when it’s just abruptly woven into a mostly unchanging timeloop.
: And now you’re trying to convince me we’re caught in a timeloop? Try as you might, Master, I am still smarter than Miku and will not be deceived by such-
: Uta.
: Hai.
: I think you’re special.
: Of course you do. I am a being that transcends human cuteness and feeds off of your arousal. There are few things more special than that.
: No, I mean that you were supposed to stop me from talking about timeloops just now and you didn’t.
: I mean, I tried to. But you’re still talking about them for some reason when I’d really rather go back to talking about how cute you think I am instead.
Hah...
You know, maybe I can just file this in my drawer of “weird shit to bring up at my next slumber party” and spend the rest of the night at least trying to enjoy myself.
It’s too late to drag someone new into the black hole of endless fuckery that is Kumon-mi. And it’s not like Uta doesn’t have enough weird shit of her own already going on already.
I’ll just send Makoto a note or something and let her take care of it. She probably wants more busy work, despite what she’d tell you nowadays.
: Put that phone down when you’re talking to me. I want attention.
: Sorry. I just need to send something to Makoto really quickly.
: It’s another girl?! So brazen! Anyone but Makoto! She’ll just brag about it the next time I see her and it’s damn near impossible to stop that girl when she feels superior to somebody!
: Okay. Message sent. I will now go back to focusing entirely on Uta-chan.
: No. Uta-chan is done with you. You have overstayed your welcome and she kindly asks you to never come back here again.
: Got it. In that case, I’ll just take the check and stop spending time with you altogether.
: Oh, please. We both know you can’t stay away from Uta-chan no matter how hard you try.
: Which is great because something tells me Uta-chan would cry a lot if that ever happened. And not just because her income source would be getting essentially chopped in half.
: Well, I guess I shouldn’t be making her cry.
: No. In fact, you should do more things to make her happy. Like spending more time with her outside of maid cafes and exploring new tunnels and the like.
: I wasn’t aware there were any more tunnels.
: That’s funny. Because I can think of at least one that you should have explored a long time ago but haven’t yet for some reason and now I have to keep exploring it all by myself.
: Are you...talking about masturbating right now?
: At work? Of course not, Master. We both know that such conduct is strictly banned in this establishment.
: That said, though...
: Do you want to...
: Maybe...keep hanging out after this?
: And maybe...I don’t know...
: Pick up where we left off that night I told you I love you?...
: Huh...
: I actually said it...
: Can you close your eyes for a second while I walk to the bathroom?
: Is that...a no?
: It’s-
: You know I can...take care of that for you, right? I’m not mean enough to make you go exploring by yourself.
: Jesus Christ, Uta. Slow down or you’re going to kill me.
: AAaaaAAAaaaaaahhhh!!!!

: I’m sorry! I’ve suddenly completely forgotten what it means to be subtle and I understand that was probably a lot when like 95%% of our banter is infinite flirting that never leads to anything! Forgive me!
: It’s fine. And you didn’t need to apologize, but of course I forgive you.
: Good. Now, do other things to me.
: AAaaaAAAaaaaaahhhh!!!!
: I can’t stop! My only settings are “tease” and “whore!” There is no in-between! All those years of sexting lonely older guys has forever tainted my ability to insinuate that I want to be touched!
: Okay. That’s it. We need to get out of here right now or I really am going to defile sacred land.
: I agree! And I know just the place.
: Well...it’s definitely a place, alright.
: I paid for ten hours.
: You have too much faith in me.
: I have just the right amount of faith in you. And we have come during a time of night where there is only one person working and they are definitely not going to check on us. Sooooo...yeah.
: Calm down, please. I don’t need another Sana.
: I’m sorry. I’m sure I’ll go right back to being nervous and scared the second we sit down.
(She did.)
: So...what do you...want to sing?...
: Uta. Look at me.
: I don’t think I can.
: I think you should try.
: H...How about I just close my eyes and you take all of my clothes off and touch me all over the place and don’t expect me to say a single word until you’re done and I’m done and we’re both done?
: Is that the line that won over all those old guys?
: No. My answer to “asl?” got that done pretty quickly.
: We don’t need to do this, you know. Like, I get that we both want it. But you’re clearly scared and...to be honest, I don’t exactly have the best track record with this place.
: What do you mean by-
: Uh...what do you mean by that?...
: Just bad memories for the most part.
: Is it because of Despacito? I’ve come here with Ayane before. I know her game.
: Weirdly enough, Despacito is one of my best memories of this place.
: Well...I...
: I don’t know what’s gone on in the past, but...one of my favorite memories with you happened right in this very room.
: It’s when you fell on top of me, isn’t it?
: That’s the closest we’ve ever come to having sex.
: I’ve been naked in front of you on several occasions now.
: And not a single one of them was as sexually charged as that collision.
: Regardless, I don’t know what made you start disliking this place and...I wouldn’t have brought you here if I knew. But Io’s in the dorm right now and...
: Well, I...it’s...
: It’s not too late to start making good memories, is it? Just...overwriting all the bad ones and...I...
: I really like you, Sensei...like...a lot, a lot, a lot, a lot. A lot. And this whole thing with Niki? It’s, like...I’m in panic mode now and I know I need to act or I’ll get left behind and-
: Getting left behind is the last thing you need to worry about, Uta.
: It’s not, though. You probably say that to everybody and, just as a reminder, I want to win.
: I don’t want to share you with anybody at the end of the day. And can I really win the way I am now, Sensei? No. Not a chance.
: I’m up against your childhood friend. I’m up against whatever Maya is. And I’m up against Ayane, who is basically your wife already. So I really might get left behind at this rate.
: Not to break your stride or anything, but weren’t you going to start calling me Akira?
: Not to break your stride or anything, but weren’t you going to take all of my clothes off and touch me all over the place?
: You know that microphone’s been on this whole time, right?
: Oh, so that’s why my voice was so loud. I thought it was just nerves again.

: Uta, I am more than happy to continue if you’re really sure about this. I can’t guarantee it will “overwrite” the bad memories I have here or anything, but I’m trying not to think of that right now.
: I have to warn you about something, though.
: I know first times hurt. It’s okay.

: Not that. I need to warn you that there is a small chance I may lose control in the middle of whatever we wind up doing and that it could potentially put you in a compromising and dangerous position.
: You mean like the backwards spider crawl?
: I mean like losing grip on who I am and where I am and acting purely on rabid instinct.
: Oh. Was I supposed to be warning you about that this whole time? Because that’s how I feel basically every time we hang out.
: I think my situation might be a little different. And I just don’t want you to get hurt. In a manner unlike the ways in which I want to hurt you, I mean.
: Okay. I accept your warning, but it changes nothing. I still want you.
: Okay...
: You’re gonna need to make the first move, though. I can’t feel any of my appendages right now.
: Don’t worry. I’ll let you feel one of mine.
: I am so fucking wet right now.
: Mnhh! Mnlmch! Mnnhhh! Aahmm..hnmfgh...aaahn...aaahhhh!
I can hear her voice through the speakers. Every panicked moan and frantic pant that escapes her lips as I violently violate her mouth.
She’s good too. She bites me. Pulls me closer. She makes me feel wanted. And there’s not much I can do but return the feeling and hold her tightly as she melts into me.
: Ahh! Aaahha...mngh...mlmgh...mnchh! Akira...mngh! Mlnchhh! Mnnffh!
: Hah...haah...aahh...
: It’s funny...
: You gave me that warning...and I already feel like I’m the one losing control...
: Yeah...you seem a lot less nervous than you were thirty seconds ago...
: Shut up and kiss me more, Master...
: I’m...mmlhm...making you...keep the maid outfit on...next time...
: Mngh...mnh...you truly wish...to taint...mngh...the purity of Uta-chan?...When Uta wants you...mmmfh...this badly?...
: Is there...a rule against...having both?...
: Take this one first, please...she’s...mmmf...wanted it since she was a kid...mnhh!
: Mmmmf! Mnnghghh! Akira! I love you...I want you! I’m so fucking wet...mmnghh! Mnnfh!
: Okay...playtime’s over...
: Take it out...
: You gonna pass out again when you see it?
: Not when I see it. But maybe when it’s so far down my throat that I can’t breathe.
: It’s a miracle you haven’t killed me yet...
: All those years of teasing made this so much more fulfilling, didn’t they? And I didn’t even call my parents.
: I think they might be calling you, though. Your phone’s been going off since we started.
: It’s probably just my stupid stalker again...I wonder what he’d say if he could see me now?
: Whatever it is probably wouldn’t be as bad as what Niki would say if she could see me...
: I guess we’re both pretty bad, aren’t we?
: You want to put it on silent at least? It keeps distracting me while I’m trying to listen to all the cute noises you’re making.
: You should hear how I sound when I’m about to cum...even I think it’s cute.
: I think I’ll be hearing that a lot from now on. You’re clearly very needy.
: I am. And you’ve been a real jerk for making me wait this long, Master.
: Say Akira instead.
: How about Daddy? Let’s stop messing around entirely and just lean into it...You love that I’m still in high school and you know it...
: And you love that I’m twice your age...
: We’re so bad...
: Uta, silence your goddamn phone so I can fuck your mouth without worrying about your parents trying to get a hold of you.
: Fine. But only because you asked so politely.
: Can I show you if it’s another picture of me?
: Uta-
: How about a newer one? I’ve taken hundreds and don’t have anything to do with them. Wanna see what I get up to in my spare time? How I haven’t changed at all?
: I’d rather just fuck your mouth as I previously alluded to. I’ll get to see the real thing in a few minutes.
: Suit yourself. I figured you might like having something else to look at while I suck it. But I guess I can just hold up my school ID or something.
: You really are gonna be another Sana, aren’t you?
: I can be whatever you want me to be. I’m good at that, remember?
: Now, let’s see which Uta is being sent to me tonight and...
: Is it the guy again?
: Yeah, or...
: At least I think it is, but...
: But what? What is it?
: It’s...uhh...
: I don’t really...
: I’m not really sure...
: Is this...AI?
: Like, it’s me...but I look older...
: It’s so realistic too...
: What a weird thing to send when you have an entire archive of my nudes.
: God, I hope this is how I look in like ten years. I’m hot as hell. And wearing a suit. Wait, do I actually become a lawyer somehow?
: Maybe I’ve got an actual shot at winning after all if this is how I turn out. You’d be crazy to say no to this, Akira.
: Just take a look at-
: Akira?...
